# jamfplatform_pro_pki_adcs (Data Source)

Read a Jamf Pro AD CS (Active Directory Certificate Services) integration by ID (Settings > Global > PKI certificates > Certificate Authorities). The certificate bytes and password are never returned by Jamf Pro and are not exposed here.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Infrastructure | Active Directory Certificate Services connector | Read | `ad-cs-settings` |



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) AD CS Settings ID assigned by Jamf Pro.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `adcs_url` (String) The AD CS Connector URL (INBOUND).
- `api_client_id` (String) UUID of the Jamf Pro API client (OUTBOUND); `null` for INBOUND.
- `ca_name` (String) The Certificate Authority name.
- `client_certificate_details` (Attributes) Metadata Jamf Pro parsed from the client certificate; `null` when none is configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--client_certificate_details))
- `connector_last_check_in` (String) Timestamp (RFC 3339) of the AD CS Connector's last check-in; `null` if it has never checked in.
- `connector_mode` (String) AD CS connector mode. Either `INBOUND` or `OUTBOUND`.
- `display_name` (String) Label for the integration.
- `fqdn` (String) Fully-qualified domain name of the AD CS server.
- `revocation_enabled` (Boolean) Whether certificate revocation is enabled.
- `server_certificate_details` (Attributes) Metadata Jamf Pro parsed from the server certificate; `null` when none is configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--server_certificate_details))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--client_certificate_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `client_certificate_details`

Read-Only:

- `expiration_date` (String) Expiry date of the client certificate.
- `filename` (String) Filename Jamf Pro recorded for the client certificate.
- `issuer` (String) Issuer distinguished name of the client certificate.
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number of the client certificate.
- `subject` (String) Subject distinguished name of the client certificate.


<a id="nestedatt--server_certificate_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `server_certificate_details`

Read-Only:

- `expiration_date` (String) Expiry date of the server certificate.
- `filename` (String) Filename Jamf Pro recorded for the server certificate.
- `issuer` (String) Issuer distinguished name of the server certificate.
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number of the server certificate.
- `subject` (String) Subject distinguished name of the server certificate.
